eventDetail.scope: The IEEE International Conference on Advanced Technologies in Electrical, Electronics and Computing Engineering (ATEEC 2026) aims to provide an international forum for researchers, academics, industry professionals, and students to present and discuss recent advances, innovative applications, and emerging trends in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, computer engineering, and software engineering. The conference covers, but is not limited to, power and energy systems, renewable energy technologies, smart grids, control and automation, communication systems, signal and image processing, embedded systems, artificial intelligence, machine learning, Internet of Things, cybersecurity, and advanced computing technologies. ATEEC 2026 also promotes interdisciplinary collaboration between academia and industry.
